rule: All original paper parts remain in paper_evidence.json. These parts have no defensible direct objective mapping; contextual links never count towards objective exposure.

exceptions.basis: PDF p.3 asks for the meaning of extinction. No objective explicitly defines it. Keep glossary support and conservation context, but do not credit habitat-destruction causes as examined by this definition part. Confidence is in this exclusion decision, not in a direct mapping.

PDF pp.3–4 asks for pesticide uptake into roots. Neither figure nor an available mark scheme determines the intended uptake process. Translocation in phloem and osmosis/water uptake are contextual links, not confirmed credited demands. No direct objective exposure assigned; do not infer pesticide entry by osmosis.
